bioAdditions: Elizabeth Mary Notarianni was born in Scranton on 24 September 1914, a daughter of Joseph Notarianni (1880-1940) and Michelina Carabia (1889-1953), both born in Italy (S1, S2). She was working as a stenographer and living at 1219 Providence Road when she married Sal Cognetti, then a soldier, on 16 October 1943; her father had died three years earlier (S1). She outlived Sal by four years, dying in Scranton on 20 September 1994, and was buried in Cathedral Cemetery (S2).
